baseline: Native54 forced-publication behavior retained. Native55 is separate and unchanged; no Cash capability inherited by this scope.

request.request_id: existing NativeWire simple request id, outer id must match
request.selectors: No actor, date, address, context, PID, source or campaign selector accepted. Current worker Full and native owner determine them. Duplicate/nested/extra/coerced fields rejected.

available_government.key: actual nonempty definition key, UTF-8 owned copy
available_government.native_flag_count: int32 0..4096, actual complete native span count
available_government.flags: complete native-order array of actual identifier names; preserve duplicates/order, count equals native_flag_count; no named-bit substitution or UI-filtered list

operations.unavailable_values: government=null; all readiness false; all four frame identity fields null

operations.presence: present or absent only; unknown source means unavailable whole DATA, never absent
operations.present_focus: actual nonempty focus key and actual nonempty linked lifestyle key
operations.present_progress: actual linked lifestyle key equals current_focus.lifestyle_key; xp_total_raw and xp_within_level_raw are native signed-Q100000 observations emitted as JSON integers, both >=0; xp_per_level is native unscaled threshold integer >=1; unspent_perk_points and used_perk_points are native named getter observations >=0. Do not reinterpret as lifetime earned or subtract Used from GetPerkPoints without native evidence.
operations.known_absence: Only verified native null/default absence: presence=absent and every other member null. Both absence tags and readiness require actual source proof; malformed pointers/unknown layout never become absence.
operations.unavailable_values: current_focus=null and current_lifestyle_progress=null; all readiness false; all four frame identity fields null

common_data.unavailable_reason: available => null, unavailable => fixed nonempty owned diagnostic string
common_data.available_native_revision: actual same-worker current publication uint64 as JSON integer; equals requested expected_revision
common_data.available_date_raw: actual same Full/live Core date, signed int32 JSON integer
common_data.available_player_character_id: actual same Full/live Core complete signed int32 Character id, including zero/negative generations, except -1 sentinel
common_data.available_requires: current worker Full basis, independent actual current Full before/after, repeated native field/source copies, complete actual main-owner/module/TLS/executing ticket/context/pump checks, actor/date/core roots and revision-source identity stable

origin.ticket_sequence: uint64 JSON integer when observed, otherwise null
origin.pump_epoch: uint64 JSON integer when observed, otherwise null
origin.thread_id: uint32 JSON integer when observed, otherwise null
origin.main_owner_observed: true only for real registered application-main ticket scope; offline_fixture and unavailable always false. Offline DATA cannot install a live producer.

common_data.provenance: Exact operation profile_id and build tuple above. Two lowercase 64-hex hashes pin separately frozen pure reader source and matching static ABI manifest; final values supplied with actual producer artefacts, not guessed in this contract. No legacy 18/full ROOT provenance alias.

envelope.typed_DATA: command_result/protocol_version1/request_id/ok=true/result=<exact typed DATA>. An observed status=unavailable remains typed read-only DATA, not root or action permission.
envelope.route_failure: Invalid request, unsupported capability, unsubmitted/reclaim-failed MQ or no typed callback result uses existing command_result ok=false/error, no result. A false route ACK cannot be converted to available typed DATA.

authority: Both features default OFF. Preserve old ROOT/LIFE schema, step, provenance, nativeQualified and all capabilities. No income/domain/council/rules/stock focus legality/selection/Root complete/finance/budget permission. Existing-focus-only Java use remains read-only; missing-focus action still requires its independent final legality path.
pending_evidence: Government key/type/complete string-flag and Lifestyle focus/progress source/caller evidence are being closed independently. This schema does not attest those values or an actual runtime source.
